Found by the #612 lane (PR #624 report) and deliberately not investigated there (scope): during RED-proof runs the local clone stopped emitting sweep lines for ~18 minutes while `/health` remained green. Reproduced on the PRE-fix revision, so unrelated to the #624 logging change.

Why it matters: a sweep that silently stops is the #384 defect class returning in runtime form — and health checks that stay green while a background producer is dead are exactly the silent-failure shape AGENTS.md now bans. The #624 done-means check had to grow a control clause (z) specifically because the clone went quiet under it — that clause refused to bank a free RED, which is how this was noticed at all.

Ask: reproduce (watch sweep cadence vs config), root-cause the stall (timer starvation? claim contention? tick swallowed by an error path?), and decide whether /health should reflect producer liveness (last-sweep-age) so quiet-but-green cannot recur.

Done means (sketch, red-first): a check that asserts sweep-complete lines appear within N× the configured interval over an M-interval window on the live clone, failing loudly on staleness; plus, if /health gains last-sweep-age, an assertion it goes non-green when the producer is stopped.

State: observed twice by one lane (PROPOSED until reproduced under this ticket); control-clause transcript in PR #624.
